description: boot-start-600 resumed from a serialized state taken after frame 150 of tests/manifests/reference/boot-start-600.json (a save point outside the perturbing boot-sequence region 29-96, R-0002 finding 5). The state and its restore-check report are local-only (ignored local/states/); a fresh host regenerates them with the regeneration command, then frames 151-599 replay with Start held at 300-305.
tested_behavior: Laboratory only: a validated state sidecar is accepted as a reference origin and repeated fresh-process restores sample identically.

inputs.injection_point: Buttons are presented on the libretro input callback before retro_run of the frame numbered `from`..`to` (0-based frames after power-on) and withdrawn before the following frame; the core polls the controllers once per frame (R-0002 finding 6). Sub-frame timing is not available.

fields.name: wram_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the 131072-byte work RAM ($7E0000-$7FFFFF) at the end of the frame

fields.name: registers
fields.description: CPU register block at the end of the frame: pc, a, x, y, s, d, b, p, e, mdr, vcounter, hcounter, field, wai, stp

fields.name: wram_0000_0200
fields.description: Raw diagnostic range $7E0000-$7E01FF (direct page and the top of the stack area). No gameplay interpretation; M1 defines fields.

regeneration_command: python3 tools/project.py reference restore-check --script tests/manifests/reference/boot-start-600.json --save-after 150 --artifacts local/states/boot-start-600-150 --report local/states/boot-start-600-150/restore-check.json && python3 tools/project.py replay run --manifest tests/manifests/replay/boot-start-600-from-state-150.json
